title: Design a URL Shortener
prompt: Design a service like bit.ly that takes a long URL and returns a short alias, and redirects visitors from the short alias back to the original URL.
requirements: Functional: shorten a URL, redirect a short code to the original URL, optional custom aliases
Non-functional: ~100M new URLs/day, read:write ratio around 100:1, redirect latency should be low (well under 100ms), short codes should not be easily guessable
discussion_points: Short-code generation scheme (counter + base62, hash-based, or random with collision retry)
Data store choice and schema (key-value vs relational) at this write volume
How to keep redirect latency low as the dataset grows
Analytics/click tracking without slowing down the redirect path
